attacks.name: Lightning Bolt
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Ice Blizzard
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Hurricane
steps: This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
After all attacks are resolved from this area attack, each enemy character with the |*Flight| |!innate| superpower targeted by this attack suffers 1 |!damage|.
Allied characters in |!range| of this attack do not suffer |!damage| from this attack.

superPowers.name: X-Men Gold (Affiliation: Uncanny X-Men)
superPowers.body: Once per Round, you may use this Leadership ability during an allied character's Activation if it is not holding an objective token. If you do, the active character may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, choose another allied character within |!range| 2 of it. Place the active character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character.|\|Additionally, when an enemy character targets an allied character with an attack, if the enemy character is not within |!range| 2 of it, the allied character may reroll 1 of its defense die.

superPowers.name: Eye of the Storm
superPowers.body: During the next attack action made by this character this Turn, add 2 dice to its attack rolls.

superPowers.name: Tempest
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 2 or less and within |!range| 3, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Goddess of Storms
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

erratas.body: "X-Men Gold" Leadership ability now costs 1 |!power| to be used. Its cover effect was replaced by a defense die reroll.
Power cost for "Eye of the Storm" decreased from 3 to 2.
"choose an allied character" was changed to "choose another allied character" in X-Men Gold Leadership's second sentence.
